title: Churn Predictions — Model Outputs
description: Stored, versioned next-renewal churn predictions. External model output and deterministic mock output are separated. Predictions alone do not establish calibration or treatment effect.

list.name: app_id
list.label: App
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT app_id AS __text, app_id AS __value FROM churn_predictions WHERE prediction_source = 'external' ORDER BY 1

list.name: model_version
list.label: Model version
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model_version AS __text, model_version AS __value FROM churn_predictions WHERE prediction_source = 'external' ORDER BY 1

list.name: horizon_days
list.label: Renewal horizon (days)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT renewal_horizon_days::text AS __text, renewal_horizon_days::text AS __value FROM churn_predictions WHERE prediction_source = 'external' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: External model data status
panels.description: A zero count means no external predictions match the selected UTC range and filters. Other external panels then show no data; mock rows never fill the gap.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS "External predictions", CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'No external predictions in selected UTC range' ELSE 'External predictions available' END AS "Status" FROM churn_predictions WHERE prediction_source = 'external' AND $__timeFilter(predicted_at) AND (${app_id:sqlstring} = '__all' OR app_id = ${app_id:sqlstring}) AND (${model_version:sqlstring} = '__all' OR model_version = ${model_version:sqlstring}) AND (${horizon_days:sqlstring} = '__all' OR renewal_horizon_days::text = ${horizon_days:sqlstring})

panels.title: External churn predictions per hour
panels.description: Count of persisted external model outputs by app, model version and renewal horizon. Prediction time is UTC. No user identifiers are shown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', predicted_at) AS "time", CONCAT(app_id, ' / ', model_id, ' ', model_version, ' / ', renewal_horizon_days, 'd') AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM churn_predictions WHERE prediction_source = 'external' AND $__timeFilter(predicted_at) AND (${app_id:sqlstring} = '__all' OR app_id = ${app_id:sqlstring}) AND (${model_version:sqlstring} = '__all' OR model_version = ${model_version:sqlstring}) AND (${horizon_days:sqlstring} = '__all' OR renewal_horizon_days::text = ${horizon_days:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: External churn probability distribution
panels.description: Counts of persisted external next-renewal probabilities in ten equal-width buckets. The 100% value is in the final bucket. This is a score distribution, not calibration or observed churn.

targets.rawSql: WITH binned AS (SELECT LEAST(width_bucket(churn_probability, 0, 1, 10), 10) AS bin FROM churn_predictions WHERE prediction_source = 'external' AND $__timeFilter(predicted_at) AND (${app_id:sqlstring} = '__all' OR app_id = ${app_id:sqlstring}) AND (${model_version:sqlstring} = '__all' OR model_version = ${model_version:sqlstring}) AND (${horizon_days:sqlstring} = '__all' OR renewal_horizon_days::text = ${horizon_days:sqlstring})) SELECT CONCAT((bin - 1) * 10, '–', bin * 10, '%') AS "Probability bucket", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Predictions" FROM binned GROUP BY bin ORDER BY bin

panels.title: External model version and horizon coverage
panels.description: Counts, mean stored probability and latest UTC prediction by app, model ID, immutable version and renewal horizon. This does not show calibration or performance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT app_id AS "App", model_id AS "Model", model_version AS "Version", renewal_horizon_days AS "Horizon (days)", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Predictions", ROUND(AVG(churn_probability)::numeric, 3)::double precision AS "Mean probability", MAX(predicted_at) AS "Latest prediction UTC" FROM churn_predictions WHERE prediction_source = 'external' AND $__timeFilter(predicted_at) AND (${app_id:sqlstring} = '__all' OR app_id = ${app_id:sqlstring}) AND (${model_version:sqlstring} = '__all' OR model_version = ${model_version:sqlstring}) AND (${horizon_days:sqlstring} = '__all' OR renewal_horizon_days::text = ${horizon_days:sqlstring}) GROUP BY app_id, model_id, model_version, renewal_horizon_days ORDER BY app_id, model_id, model_version, renewal_horizon_days

panels.title: Age of latest external prediction
panels.description: Hours since the most recent external prediction in the selected UTC range for each app, model version and horizon. A negative age indicates a timestamp quality problem.

targets.rawSql: SELECT app_id AS "App", model_id AS "Model", model_version AS "Version", renewal_horizon_days AS "Horizon (days)", ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MAX(predicted_at))) / 3600)::numeric, 2)::double precision AS "Hours since latest" FROM churn_predictions WHERE prediction_source = 'external' AND $__timeFilter(predicted_at) AND (${app_id:sqlstring} = '__all' OR app_id = ${app_id:sqlstring}) AND (${model_version:sqlstring} = '__all' OR model_version = ${model_version:sqlstring}) AND (${horizon_days:sqlstring} = '__all' OR renewal_horizon_days::text = ${horizon_days:sqlstring}) GROUP BY app_id, model_id, model_version, renewal_horizon_days ORDER BY app_id, model_id, model_version, renewal_horizon_days

panels.title: Deterministic mock predictions (separate)
panels.description: Mock fixtures only. These values are not learned churn-model output and are excluded from every external panel above.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', predicted_at) AS "time", CONCAT(app_id, ' / ', model_version, ' / ', renewal_horizon_days, 'd') AS metric, AVG(churn_probability)::double precision AS value FROM churn_predictions WHERE prediction_source = 'mock' AND $__timeFilter(predicted_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
